title: Lower bound by the minimum positive atom
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type, let $p$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $x\in\Omega$ have nonzero mass under $p$. Then the minimum mass among the points of positive mass is at most the mass of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
